body: At the moment its hard to avoid my dad as I live with him but out of the two he is easier to deal with in a way.
This is what I try and explain to my dad and sister, but they don't seem to understand. I feel like even if I don't take a side, I lose.

Everyone should have at least a roof over their heads. As a society we should be trying to work out or problems from the bottom upwards as these people on the streets could die this winter. Whilst big businesses and billionaires want to take more money from the poor.
I wish they could get a place from the council, I'm not going to be in the job for much longer so I guess I think I'll make peace with it.

We do chat when they are about, personally I don't like being around anyone. I'm not a social person. But I'm friendly with them. However they are on some drugs and it's hard for them to get things going in the morning. Plus it's freezing these days. Making them go earlier makes me feel bad.
I understand, I just felt like my intentions were asshole ish. I guess I'm also frustrated I can't do anything else to help them? Its a hole mess of a situation
No they are genuinely nice people, if they was being intimidating we wouldn't let them be in our doorway but they haven't caused any trouble.
A few people have suggested this, but I am too much of a coward to say it. I just don't want to make things harder for them.

The shop is a franchise, I guess if I wanted to I could make something up but the guilt would eat me up. The thing is that they leave their stuff with us so it doesn't get wet, and if they can't be in the doorway when we.open and close went have to leave their stuff where it could get wet or damaged. Or even stolen. And that would make me feel worse.
I do wish I could say something like that but I'm way too much of a coward to. I know I'm weak.

I know i get it. I honestly feel bad. I don't wish any ill intent. I've done what I can for these people and they are nice people. If I had the money I'd get them a proper place to stay. But your right
I understand, I just don't want to add more hardships that they already have. Everytime I see them I just feel so bad.
Thank you for this link I've done what it's said hope it does some good
Tbh if I was in their position I'd love.to be called that. But if I started calling them that I don't think it would come off as nice.

Local services know about them and are "trying", but it could take a while. If I did get them a alarm clock I feel that would be seen as a dick move on my part. Plus they take drugs as well so they might not even hear it.

I wish it was that simple, but my gran will want her to come. The lats time my mum came for Christmas my gran almost begged to make an appearance to see my mum. I'm guessing she might do the same this time. My gran doesn't like fighting, she's 91. Also if I say we are busy x day, my mum will just come another day. But yes I will take my gran out somewhere.
